offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai — Search the web and convert results to LLM-friendly text block / SERP)
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on the token usage. One API key gives you access to all search foundation products. Toy Experiment 10 Million tokens Free (Non-commercial use only, CC-BY-NC); Prototype Development 1 Billion tokens $50 = 0.050 / 1M tokens (Standard key); Production Deployment 11 Billion tokens $500 = 0.045 / 1M tokens (Premium key). 'The best part? It's free!' Reader API is available for free and offers flexible rate limit and pricing.
offerings.price_basis: Jina Search Foundation API token top-up tiers ($0.050/1M tokens Standard, $0.045/1M tokens Premium); 搜索按 token 计费, 无法换算为每千次请求价格
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens! (Toy Experiment: 10 Million tokens, Free, Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC))
offerings.output_type: Top five search results with their URLs and contents, each in clean, LLM-friendly text (JSON 可选, In Search mode it returns a list of five entries)
offerings.note: Prepend https://s.jina.ai/?q= to query; 每次请求消耗固定 token 数, 起始 10,000 tokens; 平均延迟 2.5s; 限速: 无 key 100 RPM, 免费 key 100 RPM, 付费 key 1000 RPM; 2025年5月6日起启用新定价模型; Reader 明确声明不索引或排名网页, 非消费级搜索引擎
